files.text:
' ZX CRAFT - step 1: the filled voxel renderer on its own. A 16 x 16 x 16 chunk of blocks drawn
' as filled faces (Starstrike II style) on Layer 2, front to back, every pixel written once.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' Keys: Q A forward / back, O P turn, K M look up / down, Space up, Z down. Left alone at the
' start it turns slowly round (any key stops that).
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

Dim cx As Integer, cy As Integer, cz As Integer, yaw As Integer, pitch As Integer
Dim loops As Integer, sp As Integer, demo As Integer
Dim t As Integer, t0 As Integer, l0 As Integer, fps10 As Integer

Nx.Border 0
Locate 4, 4 : Print "ZX CRAFT  STEP 1"
Locate 4, 27 : Print "QA MOVE  OP TURN  KM LOOK  SPC/Z UP"
Vox.Screen &HE3                   ' see-through outside the view (rows 0-15, 176-191: the text)
Vox.Load World.Base()
Vox.Colours World.Colours()
Vox.Build
cx = 14 * 256 : cy = 10 * 256 : cz = 2 * 256 : yaw = 216 : pitch = -12
demo = 1
t0 = Vox.Ticks()
Do
  sp = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) Then sp = 48 : demo = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA) Then sp = -48 : demo = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Then yaw = (yaw - 3) And 255 : demo = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Then yaw = (yaw + 3) And 255 : demo = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyK) And pitch < 56 Then pitch = pitch + 3 : demo = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM) And pitch > -56 Then pitch = pitch - 3 : demo = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) And cy < 24 * 256 Then cy = cy + 32 : demo = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyZ) And cy > 32 Then cy = cy - 32 : demo = 0
  If demo Then yaw = (yaw + 1) And 255
  If sp Then
    cx = cx + Vox.Sine(yaw) * sp / 128
    cz = cz + Vox.Sine(yaw + 64) * sp / 128
    If cx < -8 * 256 Then cx = -8 * 256
    If cx > 24 * 256 Then cx = 24 * 256
    If cz < -8 * 256 Then cz = -8 * 256
    If cz > 24 * 256 Then cz = 24 * 256
  End If
  Vox.Render cx, cy, cz, yaw, pitch, Vox.Page()
  Frame : Vox.Flip
  loops = loops + 1
  ' frames a second (in tenths), every second or so
  t = Vox.Ticks()
  If t - t0 >= 50 Then
    fps10 = (loops - l0) * 500 / (t - t0)
    Locate 26, 4 : Print fps10 \ 10; "."; fps10 Mod 10; " FPS "
    t0 = t : l0 = loops
  End If
Loop

files.name: Nx.cls
files.text:
' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Vox.cls
files.text:
' Vox - ZX Craft's renderer: a 16 x 16 x 16 chunk of blocks drawn as filled faces on Layer 2.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Made by gen_vox.py (all of the drawing is Z80, in Render's #asm block: its labels are its own).
'
' How a frame is drawn (Render):
'  - the camera's basis from yaw and pitch, then three small tables (TX, TY, TZ: each grid line
'    along right, up and forward), so a block corner in camera space is three adds
'  - the chunk is 64 groups of 4 x 4 x 4 cells; a group outside the view is skipped (one on its
'    edge has its cells tested one by one), the rest are taken nearest first by Manhattan
'    distance (|dx| + |dy| + |dz|, in groups, then in cells within a group). Along any line of
'    sight that distance only goes up, so this is front to back
'  - only a block's open faces that face the camera are drawn (a face list made by Build)
'  - a corner is projected once a frame (a cache of 2048 in RAM page 44, slot 7 while drawing);
'    the projection is a reciprocal table and the Next's MUL D,E. A face cut by the near plane,
'    or too far off to the side, goes the slow way: cut in 3D, projected in 16 bits, dropped when
'    off the screen, cut to a guard band
'  - each row of the screen keeps a list of what is drawn already: a face's span only fills the
'    parts that are still empty, so every pixel is written once and nothing is cleared. What is
'    left at the end is the sky
'  - the screen is 128 x 80 pixels of 2 x 2 (Layer 2 rows 16 to 175), filled with PUSH
Option Explicit

Private blk(4095) As Byte         ' the chunk: x + 16 z + 256 y (y up), 0 = air
Private cells(6143) As Byte       ' the open blocks, by group: x | z << 4, y, open faces, type
Private gstart(63) As Integer     ' each group's first in cells (in 4s)
Private gcnt(63) As Byte
Private tab(305) As Byte          ' TX, TY, TZ: 17 x (x, y, z) words each
Private sps As Integer
Private bufNo As Integer, wipeColour As Integer

' Screen colour: Layer 2 on, 256 x 192, both buffers (banks 16-18, 19-21) wiped to colour; the
' first shown, the second drawn on. (#E3 is see-through: the ULA shows there.)
Public Sub Screen(ByVal colour As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H70, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 1
  Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 255 : Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 191
  Nx.Reg &H16, 0 : Nx.Reg &H17, 0
  Nx.Reg &H15, 0                         ' sprites off; Layer 2 over the ULA and tilemap (the text)
  wipeColour = colour
  Wipe
  bufNo = 1
  Nx.Reg &H12, 16
  Out &H123B, 2
End Sub

' Back(): the buffer to draw on (0 or 1); Page(): its first 8K page (for Render)
Public Function Back() As Integer
  Back = bufNo
End Function
Public Function Page() As Integer
  Page = 32 + 6 * bufNo
End Function

' Flip: show the buffer just drawn (call it straight after Frame), draw on the other
Public Sub Flip()
  Nx.Reg &H12, 16 + 3 * bufNo
  bufNo = 1 - bufNo
End Sub

Private Sub Wipe()
#asm
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld a, 32
wp_lp:
            push af
            ld bc, #243B
            ld e, a
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            ld hl, #C000
            ld de, #C001
            ld bc, #1FFF
            ld a, ({wipeColour})
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
            pop af
            inc a
            cp 44
            jr nz, wp_lp
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
            ld sp, ({sps})
#endasm
End Sub

' Load address: the chunk from run-length data (pairs: count, block)
Public Sub Load(ByVal address As Integer)
#asm

; Load address: the chunk from run-length data (count, block; a count of 0 is 256) - 4096 blocks
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld de, {blk}
            ld bc, 4096
ld_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            push bc
            ld b, a
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
ld_r:
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            djnz ld_r
            pop bc
            ; bc -= count (the byte before the block)
            dec hl
            dec hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            inc hl
            push hl
            push de
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            or a
            jr nz, ld_c
            inc d
ld_c:
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            pop de
            pop hl
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr nz, ld_lp
            ld sp, ({sps})
            ret
#endasm
End Sub

' Colours address: the block colours (16 types x 8: -X, +X, bottom, top, -Z, +Z, the top's other
' square, spare) then the sky's (80 rows), Layer 2 colours (RRRGGGBB) - World.Colours() has them
Public Sub Colours(ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld de, fn_vox_render_rd_col     ; (Render's table: its labels are fn_vox_render_ ...)
            ld bc, 208
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' SetBlock x, y, z, block / GetBlock(x, y, z) (call Build after changes)
Public Sub SetBlock(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal b As Integer)
  blk(x + z * 16 + y * 256) = b
End Sub
Public Function GetBlock(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer) As Integer
  GetBlock = blk(x + z * 16 + y * 256)
End Function

' Build: the faces that can be seen (a block's sides next to air), a list a group
Public Sub Build()
#asm

; Build: the open faces of every block, a list a group (4 x 4 x 4 cells)
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld hl, 0
            ld (bd_tot), hl
            ld hl, {cells}
            ld (bd_p), hl
            xor a
bd_g:
            ld (bd_g0), a
            ; gstart(g) = the total so far
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld de, {gstart}
            add hl, de
            ld de, (bd_tot)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            xor a
            ld (bd_cnt), a
            ld a, (bd_g0)
            and 3
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld (bd_x0), a
            ld a, (bd_g0)
            and 12
            ld (bd_z0), a
            ld a, (bd_g0)
            rrca
            rrca
            and #3C
            ld (bd_y0), a
            ld (bd_y), a
bd_y1:
            ld a, (bd_z0)
            ld (bd_z), a
bd_z1:
            ld a, (bd_x0)
            ld (bd_x), a
bd_x1:
            ; HL = blk + x + 16 z + 256 y
            ld a, (bd_z)
            add a, a
            add a, a
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld hl, bd_x
            add a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, (bd_y)
            ld h, a
            ld de, {blk}
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jp z, bd_xn
            ld (bd_t), a
            ld c, 0
            ; -X
            ld a, (bd_x)
            or a
            jr z, bd_f0
            dec hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            or a
            jr nz, bd_f1
bd_f0:
            set 0, c
bd_f1:
            ld a, (bd_x)
            cp 15
            jr z, bd_f2
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            dec hl
            or a
            jr nz, bd_f3
bd_f2:
            set 1, c
bd_f3:
            ld a, (bd_y)
            or a
            jr z, bd_f4
            dec h
            ld a, (hl)
            inc h
            or a
            jr nz, bd_f5
bd_f4:
            set 2, c
bd_f5:
            ld a, (bd_y)
            cp 15
            jr z, bd_f6
            inc h
            ld a, (hl)
            dec h
            or a
            jr nz, bd_f7
bd_f6:
            set 3, c
bd_f7:
            ld de, 16
            ld a, (bd_z)
            or a
            jr z, bd_f8
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            add hl, de
            or a
            jr nz, bd_f9
bd_f8:
            set 4, c
bd_f9:
            ld a, (bd_z)
            cp 15
            jr z, bd_fa
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            or a
            jr nz, bd_fb
bd_fa:
            set 5, c
bd_fb:
            ld a, c
            or a
            jr z, bd_xn
            ld hl, (bd_tot)
            ld de, 1536
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jr nc, bd_xn            ; (the list is full)
            ld hl, (bd_p)
            ld a, (bd_z)
            add a, a
            add a, a
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld de, bd_x
            ex de, hl
            or (hl)
            ex de, hl
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (bd_y)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld (hl), c
            inc hl
            ld a, (bd_t)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld (bd_p), hl
            ld hl, (bd_tot)
            inc hl
            ld (bd_tot), hl
            ld hl, bd_cnt
            inc (hl)
bd_xn:
            ld hl, bd_x
            inc (hl)
            ld a, (bd_x0)
            add a, 4
            cp (hl)
            jp nz, bd_x1
            ld hl, bd_z
            inc (hl)
            ld a, (bd_z0)
            add a, 4
            cp (hl)
            jp nz, bd_z1
            ld hl, bd_y
            inc (hl)
            ld a, (bd_y0)
            add a, 4
            cp (hl)
            jp nz, bd_y1
            ; gcnt(g)
            ld a, (bd_g0)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, {gcnt}
            add hl, de
            ld a, (bd_cnt)
            ld (hl), a
            ld a, (bd_g0)
            inc a
            cp 64
            jp nz, bd_g
            ld sp, ({sps})
            ret
bd_tot:     dw 0
bd_p:       dw 0
bd_g0:      db 0
bd_cnt:     db 0
bd_x0:      db 0
bd_y0:      db 0
bd_z0:      db 0
bd_x:       db 0
bd_y:       db 0
bd_z:       db 0
bd_t:       db 0
#endasm
End Sub

' Ticks(): frames gone by (the raster line watched while drawing, and at each call)
Public Function Ticks() As Integer
#asm
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            call fn_vox_render_tk_poll
            ld hl, (fn_vox_render_tk_n)
            ld sp, ({sps})
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            ret
#endasm
End Function

' Sine(a): the sine of a (256 a turn), -127 .. 127
Public Function Sine(ByVal a As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop de
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld bc, sn_t
            add hl, bc
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            add a, a
            sbc a, a
            ld h, a
            ex de, hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            ret
sn_t:
            db 0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 16, 19, 22, 25, 28, 31, 34, 37, 40, 43, 46
            db 49, 51, 54, 57, 60, 63, 65, 68, 71, 73, 76, 78, 81, 83, 85, 88
            db 90, 92, 94, 96, 98, 100, 102, 104, 106, 107, 109, 111, 112, 113, 115, 116
            db 117, 118, 120, 121, 122, 122, 123, 124, 125, 125, 126, 126, 126, 127, 127, 127
            db 127, 127, 127, 127, 126, 126, 126, 125, 125, 124, 123, 122, 122, 121, 120, 118
            db 117, 116, 115, 113, 112, 111, 109, 107, 106, 104, 102, 100, 98, 96, 94, 92
            db 90, 88, 85, 83, 81, 78, 76, 73, 71, 68, 65, 63, 60, 57, 54, 51
            db 49, 46, 43, 40, 37, 34, 31, 28, 25, 22, 19, 16, 12, 9, 6, 3
            db 0, 253, 250, 247, 244, 240, 237, 234, 231, 228, 225, 222, 219, 216, 213, 210
            db 207, 205, 202, 199, 196, 193, 191, 188, 185, 183, 180, 178, 175, 173, 171, 168
            db 166, 164, 162, 160, 158, 156, 154, 152, 150, 149, 147, 145, 144, 143, 141, 140
            db 139, 138, 136, 135, 134, 134, 133, 132, 131, 131, 130, 130, 130, 129, 129, 129
            db 129, 129, 129, 129, 130, 130, 130, 131, 131, 132, 133, 134, 134, 135, 136, 138
            db 139, 140, 141, 143, 144, 145, 147, 149, 150, 152, 154, 156, 158, 160, 162, 164
            db 166, 168, 171, 173, 175, 178, 180, 183, 185, 188, 191, 193, 196, 199, 202, 205
            db 207, 210, 213, 216, 219, 222, 225, 228, 231, 234, 237, 240, 244, 247, 250, 253
#endasm
End Function

' Render x, y, z, yaw, pitch, page: the view from x, y, z (256 a block) turned yaw (256 a turn)
' and pitch (+ up), drawn on the Layer 2 buffer whose first 8K page is page (32 or 38)
Public Sub Render(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal yaw As Integer, ByVal pitch As Integer, ByVal page As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (rd_cx), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (rd_cy), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (rd_cz), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (rd_yaw), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (rd_pit), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (rd_page), hl
            ld ({sps}), sp          ; the real stack (call / ret inside)
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            call rd_frame
            ld sp, ({sps})
            ret

; ================================================================ a frame
rd_frame:
            ; the corner cache: 8K page 44 in slot 7 while drawing (the tilemap's page goes
            ; back after - the display reads bank 5 whatever is in the slot)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #57
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 44
            out (c), a
            ; its stamp (1 .. 7, a new one each frame; round to 1 again: every tag wiped)
            ld a, (rd_fr)
            inc a
            cp 8
            jr c, rf_s1
            ld hl, #E001
            ld de, 4
            ld c, 8
rf_w1:
            ld b, 0
rf_w2:
            ld (hl), 0
            add hl, de
            djnz rf_w2
            dec c
            jr nz, rf_w1
            ld a, 1
rf_s1:
            ld (rd_fr), a
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            ld (rd_fr5), a          ; << 5
            ld a, #FF
            ld (rd_cpage), a
            xor a
            ld (rd_full), a
            ld hl, iv_blk
            ld de, 64
            ld b, 80
rf_cl:
            ld (hl), 0
            add hl, de
            djnz rf_cl
            call rd_basis
            call rd_tables
            ld ix, {tab}
            call hdc
            ld (hd_x), hl
            ld ix, {tab} + 2
            call hdc
            ld (hd_y), hl
            ld ix, {tab} + 4
            call hdc
            ld (hd_z), hl
            ld a, (rd_cx + 1)       ; the camera's cell (floor of / 256: the high byte)
            ld (rd_ccx), a
            ld a, (rd_cy + 1)
            ld (rd_ccy), a
            ld a, (rd_cz + 1)
            ld (rd_ccz), a
            call tk_poll
            call rd_groups
            call rd_sky
            call tk_poll
            ld bc, #243B            ; slot 7 back to bank 5's second half (the tilemap)
            ld a, #57
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 11
            out (c), a
            ld bc, #243B            ; slot 6 back to bank 5's first half (the tiles)
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
            ret

; ---- HL = half of (TX(1) - TX(0)) + (TY(1) - TY(0)) + (TZ(1) - TZ(0)), the component at IX
hdc:
            ld hl, 0
            ld b, 3
hd_lp:
            ld e, (ix + 6)
            ld d, (ix + 7)
            add hl, de
            ld e, (ix + 0)
            ld d, (ix + 1)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld de, 102
            add ix, de
            djnz hd_lp
            sra h
            rr l
            ret

; ---- tk_poll: the frame count goes up when the raster line has gone round (called often
; enough - more than once a frame - it counts every frame; Ticks() reads it)
tk_poll:
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            ld h, a
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            ld l, a
            ld de, (tk_last)
            ld (tk_last), hl
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ret nc
            ld hl, (tk_n)
            inc hl
            ld (tk_n), hl
            ret
tk_last:    dw 0
tk_n:       dw 0

; ---- HL = sine (2.14) of A
rd_sin:
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld de, rd_sint
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ret
rd_neg:
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret

; ---- the camera's basis from yaw and pitch: right (cy, 0, -sy), up, forward
rd_basis:
            ld a, (rd_yaw)
            call rd_sin
            ld (b_sy), hl
            ld a, (rd_yaw)
            add a, 64
            call rd_sin
            ld (b_cy), hl
            ld a, (rd_pit)
            call rd_sin
            ld (b_sp), hl
            ld a, (rd_pit)
            add a, 64
            call rd_sin
            ld (b_cp), hl
            ld de, (b_sy)
            ld bc, (b_cp)
            call vx_fix
            ld (b_fx), hl
            ld hl, (b_sp)
            ld (b_fy), hl
            ld de, (b_cy)
            ld bc, (b_cp)
            call vx_fix
            ld (b_fz), hl
            ld hl, (b_cy)
            ld (b_rx), hl
            ld hl, (b_sy)
            call rd_neg
            ld (b_rz), hl
            ld de, (b_sy)
            ld bc, (b_sp)
            call vx_fix
            call rd_neg
            ld (b_ux), hl
            ld hl, (b_cp)
            ld (b_uy), hl
            ld de, (b_cy)
            ld bc, (b_sp)
            call vx_fix
            call rd_neg
            ld (b_uz), hl
            ret

; ---- the tables: TX(i) = (i * 256 - cx) along right, up, forward; TY(j), TZ(k) the same
rd_tables:
            ld hl, (b_rx)
            ld (mk_b1), hl
            ld hl, (b_ux)
            ld (mk_b2), hl
            ld hl, (b_fx)
            ld (mk_b3), hl
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld de, (rd_cx)
            call mk
            ld hl, 0
            ld (mk_b1), hl
            ld hl, (b_uy)
            ld (mk_b2), hl
            ld hl, (b_fy)
            ld (mk_b3), hl
            ld hl, {tab} + 102
            ld de, (rd_cy)
            call mk
            ld hl, (b_rz)
            ld (mk_b1), hl
            ld hl, (b_uz)
            ld (mk_b2), hl
            ld hl, (b_fz)
            ld (mk_b3), hl
            ld hl, {tab} + 204
            ld de, (rd_cz)
            call mk
            ret
mk:
            ld (mk_p), hl
            ld hl, 0
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (mk_d), hl
            ld b, 17
mk_lp:
            push bc
            ld de, (mk_d)
            ld bc, (mk_b1)
            call vx_fix
            call mk_put
            ld de, (mk_d)
            ld bc, (mk_b2)
            call vx_fix
            call mk_put
            ld de, (mk_d)
            ld bc, (mk_b3)
            call vx_fix
            call mk_put
            ld hl, (mk_d)
            inc h
            ld (mk_d), hl
            pop bc
            djnz mk_lp
            ret
mk_put:
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (mk_p)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld (mk_p), hl
            ret

; ---- cc: the camera space of grid point (cn_i, cn_j, cn_k) -> cc_x, cc_y, cc_z
cc:
            ld a, (cn_i)
            ld c, a
            add a, a
            add a, c
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld ix, {tab}
            add ix, de
            ld a, (cn_j)
            ld c, a
            add a, a
            add a, c
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld iy, {tab} + 102
            add iy, de
            ld a, (cn_k)
            ld c, a
            add a, a
            add a, c
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld hl, {tab} + 204
            add hl, de
            ; x = TX.x + TZ.x (TY.x is 0)
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            inc hl
            push hl
            ld l, (ix + 0)
            ld h, (ix + 1)
            add hl, de
            ld (cc_x), hl
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            inc hl
            push hl
            ld l, (ix + 2)
            ld h, (ix + 3)
            add hl, de
            ld e, (iy + 2)
            ld d, (iy + 3)
            add hl, de
            ld (cc_y), hl
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld l, (ix + 4)
            ld h, (ix + 5)
            add hl, de
            ld e, (iy + 4)
            ld d, (iy + 5)
            add hl, de
            ld (cc_z), hl
            ret

; ---- cproj: cc_x, cc_y, cc_z to the screen: B = x', C = y' (255, 255 when not on the fast path)
; x' = 128 + 64 x / z, y' = 128 - 64 y / z, by a reciprocal (3 ranges of z) and 3 MUL D,E
cproj:
            ld hl, (cc_z)
            ld a, h
            cp #40
            jp nc, cp_bad           ; z < 0 or z >= 16384
            ld de, 32
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp c, cp_bad            ; z < 32
            add hl, de
            add hl, hl
            ld (cp_2z), hl
            ; |x| <= 2z, |y| <= 2z
            ld hl, (cc_x)
            ld a, h
            ld (cp_sx), a
            or a
            jp p, cp_1
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
cp_1:
            ld (cp_ax), hl
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (cp_2z)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp c, cp_bad
            ld hl, (cc_y)
            ld a, h
            ld (cp_sy), a
            or a
            jp p, cp_2
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
cp_2:
            ld (cp_ay), hl
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (cp_2z)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp c, cp_bad
            call cp_rec
            jp cp_xy
; ---- cp16: cc_x, cc_y, cc_z (z NEAR .. 16383) to the screen in 16 bits: HL = x', DE = y'
cp16:
            ld hl, (cc_x)
            ld a, h
            ld (cp_sx), a
            or a
            jp p, c6_1
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
c6_1:
            ld (cp_ax), hl
            ld hl, (cc_y)
            ld a, h
            ld (cp_sy), a
            or a
            jp p, c6_2
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
c6_2:
            ld (cp_ay), hl
            call cp_rec
            ld de, (cp_ax)
            call cp_mq
            ld a, (cp_sx)
            or a
            jp m, c6_xn
            ld de, 128
            add hl, de
            jr c6_xc
c6_xn:
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 128
            or a
            sbc hl, de
c6_xc:
            ld (cp_wx), hl
            ld de, (cp_ay)
            call cp_mq
            ld a, (cp_sy)
            or a
            jp p, c6_yn
            ld de, 128
            add hl, de
            jr c6_yc
c6_yn:
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 128
            or a
            sbc hl, de
c6_yc:
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (cp_wx)
            ret
; ---- cp_rec: the reciprocal of cc_z: z < 1024 RA(z); < 4096 RB((z - 1024) / 4); else RC((z - 4096) / 16)
cp_rec:
            ld hl, (cc_z)
            ld a, h
            cp 4
            jr nc, cp_r2
            add hl, hl
            ld de, rd_ra
            add hl, de
            xor a
            jr cp_r4
cp_r2:
            cp 16
            jr nc, cp_r3
            ld de, -1024
            add hl, de
            srl h
            rr l
            res 0, l                ; (/ 4 * 2)
            ld de, rd_rb
            add hl, de
            ld a, 1
            jr cp_r4
cp_r3:
            ld de, -4096
            add hl, de
            srl h
            rr l
            srl h
            rr l
            srl h
            rr l
            res 0, l                ; (/ 16 * 2)
            ld de, rd_rc
            add hl, de
            ld a, 2
cp_r4:
            ld (cp_mode), a
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (cp_r), hl
            ret
cp_xy:
            ; x' = 128 +- q
            ld de, (cp_ax)
            call cp_mq
            ld a, (cp_sx)
            or a
            jp m, cp_xn
            ld de, 128
            add hl, de
            jr cp_xc
cp_xn:
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 128
            or a
            sbc hl, de
cp_xc:
            ld a, h
            or a
            jr nz, cp_bad
            ld a, l
            cp 255
            jr z, cp_bad
            ld (cp_X), a
            ; y' = 128 -+ q
            ld de, (cp_ay)
            call cp_mq
            ld a, (cp_sy)
            or a
            jp p, cp_yn
            ld de, 128
            add hl, de
            jr cp_yc
cp_yn:
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 128
            or a
            sbc hl, de
cp_yc:
            ld a, h
            or a
            jr nz, cp_bad
            ld a, l
            cp 255
            jr z, cp_bad
            ld c, a
            ld a, (cp_X)
            ld b, a
            ret
cp_bad:
            ld bc, #FFFF
            ret
; HL = q: the product a (DE) x R (cp_r) as ah rh << 8 + ah rl + al rh (al rl left out), then
; >> 7 (z < 1024), >> 12 (< 4096), >> 14
cp_mq:
            ld a, d
            ld (cp_ah), a
            ld a, e
            ld (cp_al), a
            ld bc, (cp_r)
            ld e, b                 ; D = ah, E = rh
cp_zm1:
            db #ED, #30             ; mul d, e: ah rh
            ld h, d
            ld l, e
            ld a, (cp_ah)
            ld d, a
            ld e, c
cp_zm2:
            db #ED, #30             ; ah rl
            push de
            ld a, (cp_al)
            ld d, a
            ld e, b
cp_zm3:
            db #ED, #30             ; al rh
            ex de, hl               ; HL = al rh, DE = ah rh
            pop bc
            add hl, bc              ; HL = ah rl + al rh (a carry is 256 in DE)
            jr nc, cp_m1
            inc d
cp_m1:
            ld a, h                 ; U = DE + H, the low byte L
            add a, e
            ld e, a
            jr nc, cp_m2
            inc d
cp_m2:
            ex de, hl               ; HL = U, E = the low byte
            ld a, (cp_mode)
            or a
            jr nz, cp_m3
            sla e
            adc hl, hl
            ret
cp_m3:
            ld b, 4
            dec a
            jr z, cp_m4
            ld b, 6
cp_m4:
            srl h
            rr l
            djnz cp_m4
            ret

; ================================================================ groups, front to back
rd_groups:
            ld hl, gh
            ld de, gh + 1
            ld bc, 15
            ld (hl), #FF
            ldir
            ; the camera's group: cell / 4, kept to -1 .. 4
            ld a, (rd_ccx)
            call gq
            ld (rd_cgx), a
            ld a, (rd_ccy)
            call gq
            ld (rd_cgy), a
            ld a, (rd_ccz)
            call gq
            ld (rd_cgz), a
            xor a
gr_lp:
            ld (gr_g), a
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld de, {gcnt}
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jp z, gr_next
            ; its middle, in camera space
            ld a, (gr_g)
            and 3
            add a, a
            add a, a
            add a, 2
            ld (cn_i), a
            ld a, (gr_g)
            and 12
            add a, 2
            ld (cn_k), a
            ld a, (gr_g)
            rrca
            rrca
            and #3C
            add a, 2
            ld (cn_j), a
            call cc
            ; z < -887: behind
            ld hl, (cc_z)
            ld de, -887
            call cmps
            jp c, gr_next
            ; x - z > 1254, -x - z > 1254
            ld hl, (cc_x)
            ld de, (cc_z)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld de, 1254
            call cmpgt
            jp c, gr_next
            ld hl, (cc_x)
            call rd_neg
            ld de, (cc_z)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld de, 1254
            call cmpgt
            jp c, gr_next
            ; t = z >> 1 + z >> 3: y - t > 1046, -y - t > 1046
            ld hl, (cc_z)
            sra h
            rr l
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            add hl, de
            ld (gr_t), hl
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (cc_y)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld de, 1046
            call cmpgt
            jp c, gr_next
            ld hl, (cc_y)
            call rd_neg
            ld de, (gr_t)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld de, 1046
            call cmpgt
            jp c, gr_next
            ; inside the view altogether? then its cells needn't be tested one by one
            ld b, 1
            ld hl, (cc_z)
            ld de, 887
            call cmpgt
            jr nc, gr_i9
            ld hl, (cc_x)
            ld de, (cc_z)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld de, -1254
            call cmps
            jr nc, gr_i9
            ld hl, (cc_x)
            call rd_neg
            ld de, (cc_z)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld de, -1254
            call cmps
            jr nc, gr_i9
            ld hl, (cc_y)
            ld de, (gr_t)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld de, -1046
            call cmps
            jr nc, gr_i9
            ld hl, (cc_y)
            call rd_neg
            ld de, (gr_t)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld de, -1046
            call cmps
            jr nc, gr_i9
            ld b, 0
gr_i9:
            ld a, (gr_g)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, gst
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), b
            ; d = |gx - cgx| + |gy - cgy| + |gz - cgz|
            ld a, (gr_g)
            and 3
            ld hl, rd_cgx
            call absd
            ld c, a
            ld a, (gr_g)
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            and 3
            ld hl, rd_cgy
            call absd
            add a, c
            ld c, a
            ld a, (gr_g)
            rrca
            rrca
            and 3
            ld hl, rd_cgz
            call absd
            add a, c
            ; gnext(g) = gh(d), gh(d) = g
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, gh
            add hl, de
            ld b, (hl)
            ld a, (gr_g)
            ld (hl), a
            ld e, a
            ld hl, gnext
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), b
gr_next:
            ld a, (gr_g)
            inc a
            cp 64
            jp nz, gr_lp
            ; the groups, nearest first
            xor a
gr_d:
            ld (gr_dd), a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, gh
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
gr_w:
            cp #FF
            jr z, gr_dn
            ld (gr_g), a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, gst
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (dg_st), a
            ld a, (rd_full)
            cp 80
            ret z
            call do_group
            call tk_poll
            ld a, (gr_g)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, gnext
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            jr gr_w
gr_dn:
            ld a, (gr_dd)
            inc a
            cp 16
            jr nz, gr_d
            ret
; A = cell / 4 (arithmetic), kept to -1 .. 4
gq:
            sra a
            sra a
            bit 7, a
            jr z, gq1
            cp #FF
            ret nc
            ld a, #FF
            ret
gq1:
            cp 5
            ret c
            ld a, 4
            ret
; A = |A - (HL)| (signed bytes, small)
absd:
            sub (hl)
            ret p
            neg
            ret
; carry if HL < DE (signed)
cmps:
            ld a, h
            xor #80
            ld h, a
            ld a, d
            xor #80
            ld d, a
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ret
; carry if HL > DE (signed)
cmpgt:
            ex de, hl
            jr cmps

; ---- a group: its cells by Manhattan distance from the camera's cell, nearest first
do_group:
            ld a, (gr_g)
            and 3
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld hl, rd_ccx
            call mind
            ld c, a
            ld a, (gr_g)
            rrca
            rrca
            and #3C
            ld hl, rd_ccy
            call mind
            add a, c
            ld c, a
            ld a, (gr_g)
            and 12
            ld hl, rd_ccz
            call mind
            add a, c
            ld (dg_min), a
            ld hl, hb
            ld de, hb + 1
            ld bc, 9
            ld (hl), #FF
            ldir
            ; the cells: {cells} + gstart(g) * 4
            ld a, (gr_g)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld de, {gstart}
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld de, {cells}
            add hl, de
            ld (dg_p), hl
            ld a, (gr_g)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, {gcnt}
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (dg_n), a
            ld ix, (dg_p)
            ld c, 0
dg_b:
            ; d = |x - ccx| + |y - ccy| + |z - ccz| - dmin
            ld a, (ix + 0)
            and 15
            ld hl, rd_ccx
            call absd
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            ld hl, rd_ccy
            call absd
            add a, b
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ix + 0)
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            and 15
            ld hl, rd_ccz
            call absd
            add a, b
            ld hl, dg_min
            sub (hl)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, hb
            add hl, de
            ld b, (hl)
            ld (hl), c
            ld e, c
            ld hl, cnext
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), b
            ld de, 4
            add ix, de
            inc c
            ld a, (dg_n)
            cp c
            jr nz, dg_b
            ; nearest first
            xor a
dg_k:
            ld (dg_bk), a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, hb
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
dg_w:
            cp #FF
            jr z, dg_kn
            ld (dg_c), a
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld de, (dg_p)
            add hl, de
            call do_cell
            ld a, (dg_c)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, cnext
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            jr dg_w
dg_kn:
            ld a, (dg_bk)
            inc a
            cp 10
            jr nz, dg_k
            ret
; A = how far (HL) (a cell) is from the span A .. A + 3 along one axis
mind:
            ld b, a
            ld a, (hl)
            sub b
            jp m, md_lo             ; camera below the span: lo - c
            sub 3
            ret nc                  ; above: c - lo - 3
            xor a
            ret
md_lo:
            neg
            ret

; ---- a cell (HL = its record: x | z << 4, y, faces open, type): its faces towards the camera
do_cell:
            ld a, (hl)
            ld e, a
            and 15
            ld (fc_x), a
            ld d, a                 ; D = x

            ld a, (fc_f)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0

            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, rd_ft
            add hl, de

            ld hl, s1
            ld (sl_q), hl
            xor a
            ld (sl_nr), a

            push bc
            ld hl, (fc_tp)
            ld a, (fc_x)
            add a, (hl)
            ld (cn_i), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (fc_y)
            add a, (hl)
            ld (cn_j), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (fc_z)
            add a, (hl)
            ld (cn_k), a
            inc hl
            inc hl
            inc hl
            ld (fc_tp), hl
            call cc
            ld hl, (sl_q)
            ld de, (cc_x)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld de, (cc_y)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld de, (cc_z)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld (sl_q), hl

            ld hl, (cc_z)
            ld a, h
            or a
            jp m, sl_nr1
            cp #40

            ld de, 32
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jr nc, sl_nx
sl_nr1:

            inc (hl)
sl_nx:
            pop bc
            djnz sl_lp
            ld a, 4
            ld (sl_n), a
            ld a, (sl_nr)
            or a
            ld hl, s1
            jp z, sl_proj
            cp 4
            ret z                   ; all too near

            ld (sl_q), hl
            xor a
            ld (sl_m), a
            ld (sl_i), a
sz_lp:
            ld a, (sl_i)
            call sl_ab6             ; IX = a, IY = b (6 byte points from s1)
            ld l, (ix + 4)
            ld h, (ix + 5)
            ld de, 32
            call cmps
            ccf
            sbc a, a
            ld (sl_ain), a          ; #FF in
            ld l, (iy + 4)
            ld h, (iy + 5)
            ld de, 32
            call cmps
            ccf
            sbc a, a
            ld (sl_bin), a
            ld a, (sl_ain)
            or a
            jr z, sz_1
            ld b, 6
            push ix
            pop hl
            call sl_put
sz_1:
            ld a, (sl_ain)
            ld hl, sl_bin
            cp (hl)
            jp z, sz_n
            ; t0 = NEAR - a.z, dz = b.z - a.z
            ld l, (ix + 4)
            ld h, (ix + 5)
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 32
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (sl_t0), hl
            ld l, (iy + 4)
            ld h, (iy + 5)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (sl_dz), hl
            ld l, (ix + 0)          ; x
            ld h, (ix + 1)
            ld e, (iy + 0)
            ld d, (iy + 1)
            call sl_lerp
            ld (sl_v), hl
            ld l, (ix + 2)          ; y
            ld h, (ix + 3)
            ld e, (iy + 2)
            ld d, (iy + 3)
            call sl_lerp
            ld (sl_v + 2), hl
            ld hl, 32
            ld (sl_v + 4), hl
            ld hl, sl_v
            ld b, 6
            call sl_put
sz_n:
            ld a, (sl_i)
            inc a
            ld (sl_i), a
            cp 4
            jp nz, sz_lp
            ld a, (sl_m)
            cp 3
            ret c
            ld (sl_n), a
            ld hl, s2
sl_proj:
            ; HL = the points (x, y, z), sl_n of them: projected (16 bits) into s3
            ld (sl_src), hl
            ld hl, s3
            ld (sl_q), hl
            ld a, (sl_n)
            ld b, a
sp_lp:
            push bc
            ld hl, (sl_src)
            ld de, cc_x
            ld bc, 6
            ldir
            ld (sl_src), hl
            call cp16
            push de
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (sl_q)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            pop de
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld (sl_q), hl
            pop bc
            djnz sp_lp

            ld ix, s3
            ld hl, 32767
            ld (bx_x0), hl
            ld (bx_y0), hl
            ld hl, -32768
            ld (bx_x1), hl
            ld (bx_y1), hl

            ret c

            inc hl

            pop de
            pop hl
            jr nc, bx_1

            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            dec hl
            ex de, hl

            inc de
            inc de
            inc de
            push hl
            push de
            ex de, hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ex de, hl
            call cmpgt
            pop de
            pop hl
            ret nc
            ex de, hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            ret

            ld a, (sl_n)
            ld (rs_n), a
            ld b, a
            ld de, 0
sb_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            push hl
            ld hl, px
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), a
            pop hl
            inc hl
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            push hl
            ld hl, py
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), a
            pop hl
            inc hl
            inc hl
            inc e
            djnz sb_lp

; IX = point A of s1, IY = point (A + 1) mod sl_n (6 bytes each)
sl_ab6:
            ld b, a
            add a, a
            add a, b
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld ix, s1
            add ix, de
            ld a, b
            inc a
            ld hl, sl_n
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sl_ab1
            xor a
sl_ab1:
            ld b, a
            add a, a
            add a, b
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld iy, s1
            add iy, de
            ret
; copy B bytes from HL to (sl_q), one more point
sl_put:
            ld de, (sl_q)
            ld c, b
            ld b, 0
            ldir
            ld (sl_q), de
            ld hl, sl_m
            inc (hl)
            ret
; HL = a + (b - a) * sl_t0 / sl_dz, a = HL, b = DE
sl_lerp:
            push hl
            ex de, hl
            pop de
            push de
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ex de, hl
            ld bc, (sl_t0)
            call vx_muls
            ld bc, (sl_dz)
            call vx_divs
            pop de
            add hl, de

; HL = DE * 64 / BC, kept to +-12000
div64:
            push bc
            ld bc, 64
            call vx_muls
            pop bc
            call vx_divs
            ld de, 12000
            push hl
            call cmpgt
            pop hl
            jr nc, dv_1

; clip2: the polygon at HL (sl_n points, x, y words) cut by c2_ax (0 x, 2 y) >= / <= c2_lim

clip2:
            ld (c2_src), hl
            ld (sl_q), de
            xor a
            ld (sl_m), a
            ld (sl_i), a
c2_lp:
            ; IX = point i, IY = point i + 1 mod n
            ld a, (sl_i)
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld ix, (c2_src)
            add ix, de
            ld a, (sl_i)
            inc a
            ld hl, sl_n
            cp (hl)
            jr c, c2_a
            xor a
c2_a:
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld iy, (c2_src)
            add iy, de
            push ix
            pop hl
            call c2_in
            ld (sl_ain), a
            push iy
            pop hl
            call c2_in
            ld (sl_bin), a
            ld a, (sl_ain)
            or a
            jr z, c2_1
            push ix
            pop hl
            ld b, 4
            call sl_put
c2_1:
            ld a, (sl_ain)
            ld hl, sl_bin
            cp (hl)
            jp z, c2_n
            ; t = a.o + (b.o - a.o) * (lim - a.ax) / (b.ax - a.ax)
            ld a, (c2_ax)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            push ix
            pop hl
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; a.ax
            ld hl, (c2_lim)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (sl_t0), hl
            push de
            ld a, (c2_ax)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            push iy
            pop hl
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            pop de
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (sl_dz), hl
            ld a, (c2_ax)
            xor 2
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            push iy
            pop hl
            add hl, de
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)
            push ix
            pop hl
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld d, b
            ld e, c
            call sl_lerp            ; the other coordinate
            ld a, (c2_ax)
            or a
            jr nz, c2_y
            ld (sl_v + 2), hl
            ld hl, (c2_lim)
            ld (sl_v), hl
            jr c2_p
c2_y:
            ld (sl_v), hl
            ld hl, (c2_lim)
            ld (sl_v + 2), hl
c2_p:
            ld hl, sl_v
            ld b, 4
            call sl_put
c2_n:
            ld a, (sl_i)
            inc a
            ld (sl_i), a
            ld hl, sl_n
            cp (hl)
            jp nz, c2_lp
            ld a, (sl_m)
            ld (sl_n), a
            cp 3

c2_in:
            ld a, (c2_ax)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld de, (c2_lim)
            ld a, (c2_ge)
            or a
            jr nz, c2_le
            call cmps               ; keep a >= lim: C = a < lim

            sbc a, a
            ret

            call cmpgt              ; keep a <= lim: C = a > lim

; ================================================================ filling a polygon
; raster: px, py (rs_n points, bytes: x' 64 .. 191 and y' 88 .. 167 are on the screen), colour
; fl_col: the left and right edge of each row (ed_u, ed_d), then each row's span to cover
raster:
            ld ix, px
            ld a, (rs_n)
            ld b, a
            ld hl, #00FF            ; H = max x, L = min x
            ld de, #00FF            ; D = max y, E = min y
rs_mm:
            ld a, (ix + 0)
            cp l
            jr nc, rs_m1
            ld l, a
rs_m1:
            cp h
            jr c, rs_m2
            ld h, a
rs_m2:
            ld a, (ix + 16)
            cp e
            jr nc, rs_m3
            ld e, a
rs_m3:
            cp d
            jr c, rs_m4
            ld d, a
rs_m4:
            inc ix
            djnz rs_mm
            ; all off one side of the screen: nothing
            ld a, h
            cp 64
            ret c
            ld a, l
            cp 192
            ret nc
            ld a, d
            cp 88
            ret c
            ld a, e
            cp 168
            ret nc
            ; the rows: ytop = max(min y, 88) .. ybot = min(max y, 168)
            cp 88
            jr nc, rs_t
            ld a, 88
rs_t:
            ld (rs_top), a
            ld e, a
            ld a, d
            cp 168
            jr c, rs_b
            ld a, 168
rs_b:
            ld (rs_bot), a
            sub e
            ret c
            ret z
            ; the rows' edges to start with: left 255, right 0 (no span)
            ld b, a
            ld l, e
            ld h, ed_u / 256
rs_df:
            ld (hl), 255
            inc h
            ld (hl), 0
            dec h
            inc l
            djnz rs_df
            ; the edges (the first point again after the last)
            ld a, (px)
            ld (ix + 0), a
            ld a, (py)
            ld (ix + 16), a
            ld ix, px
            ld a, (rs_n)
rs_e:

; 2.14 fixed point: from SOLAR / SOL UNICORN's View.cls, for gen_vox.py
; DEHL = DE * BC, signed
vx_muls:
            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (vx_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, vx_m1
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a

            bit 7, b
            jr z, vx_m2
            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a

            call vx_umul            ; DEHL = DE * BC, unsigned
            ld a, (vx_sg)
            bit 7, a
            ret z

            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d

            ld a, d
            xor b
            ld (vx_sg), a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, vx_d1
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, e
            ld e, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, d
            ld d, a

            bit 7, b
            jr z, vx_d2
            xor a
            sub c
            ld c, a
            sbc a, a
            sub b
            ld b, a

            ld a, b
            or c
            jr nz, vx_d3
            ld hl, 0
            ret

            ex de, hl               ; HL = high, DE = low
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
            jr c, vx_d4
            ld hl, 32767
            jr vx_d7

            add hl, bc
            ld a, 16

            sla e
            rl d
            adc hl, hl

            or a

            jr nc, vx_d6
            add hl, bc
            jr vx_d6n

            inc e

            ret z
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret
